mathematical_corrections: EBR horizon edge: 6h window for t <= 18 shrinks to 1h (12,609 Wh) at t=23.
Terminal target at t=23 is max(12,609 Wh, 100,000 Wh) = 100,000 Wh.
Candidate 1 headroom formula can be negative on sunny days (infeasible on 53/173 origins) and raises diesel under J2 > J3. Marked BLOCKED / NOT READY.
Candidate 2 night-wind clamp inactive during Arctic summer solstice. Replaced with unbundled Variant S and Variant SW.
Removed synthetic 5,000 W wind margin and unverified 2-hour (25.2 kWh) emergency floor.
Variant S input: consumes bundle.solar_generation.point directly in Watts; no 51 * I or 60 kW cap in controller; 51 W/(W/m2) clarified as campaign adapter prototype.
Critical demand input: dynamic vector critical_demand[k] = min(11600.0, demand.point[k]), not a scalar constant.
No extra reserve floor: physical battery floor E_min = 40,000 Wh remains enforced in GAP19 busbar constraints.
Variant SW synthetic wind warning: campaign wind series is synthetic (4500 + 5000*sin); results cannot generalize to real wind forecasting; substantially replicates prior critical-aware experiment.
Candidate 3 lambda derivation (0.00035 L/Wh) mathematically incorrect. Reclassified as future parametric sweep requiring code changes.
Candidate 4 attribution corrected: 68.4% is total EBR-OFF fuel reduction, not step-0 alone. Resolved 2h vs 3h conflict. Flagged non-linearity for t >= 1.
protocol_corrections: Rejected 6 diagnostic origins as validation set due to circularity and insufficient statistical power.
Mandated full 123-origin closed-loop campaign framework labelled as pre-specified paired historical evaluation set, not a pristine holdout.
Separated terminal target removal from primary candidate experiment to preserve causal isolation.
Defined exact research critical-load metrics (critical_unmet, critical_reliability) and prohibited campaign legacy reliability_pct.
Mandated 95% BCa bootstrap confidence intervals and paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test across all 123 origins.
Required safety-gate threshold preregistration before execution.
Replaced subjective 0-10 scores with qualitative multi-criteria evaluation.

Candidate_2_Net_Deficit_EBR.core_question: Can forecast-conditioned net-critical-deficit EBR reduce unnecessary diesel commitment relative to unconditional EBR while preserving critical-load reliability?

Candidate_3_Elastic_Slack.reason: Requires GAP19 objective code modification; derivation refuted; requires parametric sweep.

Candidate_4_State_Triggered_JIT.reason: Non-linear for t >= 1 without big-M; lacks verified diesel startup delay.
